description: This file contains utility functions for testing Playwright-based UI interactions and API responses related to form responses, bookings, iframes, and calendar integrations within a web application.

methods.name: getQueuedFormResponse
methods.description: Fetches a queued form response from the database by ID.

methods.name: getAllFormResponses
methods.description: Retrieves all form responses for a given form ID, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: getLatestQueuedFormResponse
methods.description: Fetches the most recent queued form response for a specific form ID.

methods.name: deleteAllBookingsByEmail
methods.description: Deletes all bookings associated with a specific email.

methods.name: getBooking
methods.description: Retrieves a booking by its ID, including attendees; throws error if not found.

methods.name: getEmbedIframe
methods.description: Waits for and retrieves the embed iframe element within a page based on namespace and pathname.

methods.name: ensureEmbedIframe
methods.description: Ensures the embed iframe exists and returns it; throws error if not found.

methods.name: bookFirstEvent
methods.description: Automates booking the first available event for a user, navigating through UI.

methods.name: bookEvent
methods.description: Performs the booking process by filling form fields and submitting.

methods.name: rescheduleEvent
methods.description: Reschedules an existing event by selecting a new time and confirming.

methods.name: installAppleCalendar
methods.description: Automates installation of Apple Calendar app via UI.

methods.name: assertNoRequestIsBlocked
methods.description: Sets up a listener to assert that no network request is blocked due to browser restrictions.

methods.name: expectEmbedIFrameToBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the embed iframe with a specific namespace is visible.

methods.name: expectActualFormResponseConnectedToQueuedFormResponse
methods.description: Verifies that a queued form response is connected to an actual response with expected number of field values.

methods.name: cancelBookingThroughEmbed
methods.description: Performs cancellation of a booking through an embedded iframe UI.
